description:
In a multinational company's annual audit process, the audit coordinator initiates the audit process by sending a notification to the regional office.
The regional office prepares financial statements and gathers necessary documents.
Concurrently, the compliance team checks for any regulatory updates that might affect the audit.
Afterward, the regional office submits the documents to the central audit team.
The central audit team reviews the submission.
If discrepancies are found, they request clarifications from the regional office.
The regional office provides the necessary clarifications.
Once all documents are reviewed without issues, the audit team conducts a risk assessment.
The risk assessment includes evaluating financial risks, operational risks, and compliance risks, which can be done in any order but must all be completed.
If high risk is identified, then a detailed investigation is launched.
The investigation includes data analysis, interviews, and, in certain cases, site visits.
After all risks are addressed, the audit team compiles the audit report.
The report is reviewed by the audit director.
The audit director may approve the report or send it back for revisions.
If revisions are required, the audit team updates the report accordingly and resubmits it to be reviewed again by the audit director.
Once approved, the final report is distributed to the executive board and archived.
The entire audit process is then closed.

  <bpmn:process id="Process_AnnualAudit" name="Annual Audit Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_AuditRoles">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelStart_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareStatements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelStart_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ComplianceTeam" name="Compliance Team">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Submission_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Discrepancy_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRisk_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Investigation_Fork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DataAnalysis</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Interviews</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SiteVisit_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SiteVisits</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Investigation_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RisksAddressed_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileAuditReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateAuditReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeFinalReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit Director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportReview_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewAuditReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportDecision_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" name="Audit initiated"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send audit notification to regional office"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelStart_Split" name="Start concurrent preparation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareStatements" name="Prepare financial statements and gather documents"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check regulatory updates affecting audit"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelStart_Join" name="Preparation completed"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents to central audit team"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Submission_Merge" name="Submission or clarification received"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submission"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" name="Discrepancies found?" default="Flow_NoDiscrepancies"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestClarifications" name="Request clarifications from regional office"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide necessary clarifications"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split" name="Start risk assessment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" name="Evaluate financial risks"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" name="Evaluate operational risks"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" name="Evaluate compliance risks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join" name="Risk assessment completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" name="High risk identified?" default="Flow_NoHighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Investigation_Fork" name="Launch investigation activities"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DataAnalysis" name="Perform data analysis"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Interviews" name="Conduct interviews"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" name="Site visit required?" default="Flow_NoSiteVisit"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SiteVisits" name="Perform site visits"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge" name="Site visit step completed"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Investigation_Join" name="Investigation activities completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RisksAddressed_Merge" name="All risks addressed"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompileAuditReport" name="Compile audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportReview_Merge" name="Report submitted for review"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewAuditReport" name="Review audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportDecision_Split" name="Report approved?" default="Flow_RevisionsRequired"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateAuditReport" name="Update audit report with required revisions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DistributeFinalReport" name="Distribute final report to executive board"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ArchiveReport" name="Archive final report"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelStart_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareStatements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_PrepareStatements" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelStart_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelStart_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart_Join" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_Submission_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_Submission_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ReviewSubmission" targetRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestClarifications">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${discrepanciesFound == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarifications" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="Gateway_Submission_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDiscrepancies" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split" targetRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split" targetRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split" targetRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join" targetRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Investigation_Fork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${highRiskIdentified == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHighRisk" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" targetRef="Gateway_RisksAddressed_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_1" sourceRef="Gateway_Investigation_Fork" targetRef="Task_DataAnalysis"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_2" sourceRef="Gateway_Investigation_Fork" targetRef="Task_Interviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Investigation_Fork" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_4" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" targetRef="Task_SiteVisits">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${siteVisitRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSiteVisit" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_5" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisits" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_6" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Investigation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_7" sourceRef="Task_DataAnalysis" targetRef="Gateway_Investigation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_8" sourceRef="Task_Interviews" targetRef="Gateway_Investigation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_9" sourceRef="Gateway_Investigation_Join" targetRef="Gateway_RisksAddressed_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_RisksAddressed_Merge" targetRef="Task_CompileAuditReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_CompileAuditReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportReview_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportReview_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReviewAuditReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_ReviewAuditReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportDecision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportDecision_Split" targetRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reportApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RevisionsRequired" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportDecision_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateAuditReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_UpdateAuditReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportReview_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="EndEvent_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
